catalysts.name: Carnival Corporation
catalysts.what: Q3 adjusted EPS $1.43 crushed the $0.35 estimate on $8.43B revenue (+3.4% YoY, record net income $1.9B); FY26 EPS guidance raised to $2.24 and debt cut below $24B. Stock rallied about +10.4% the next session.

catalysts.name: Akamai Technologies
catalysts.what: Signed an $11.6B, seven-year cloud-services deal with Anthropic (expandable to about $20B); Anthropic also received a warrant to buy roughly 5% of Akamai at $111.33/share. Shares jumped as much as +16.4% the following session.

catalysts.name: The Boeing Company
catalysts.what: Selected over Northrop Grumman for the US Navy's F/A-XX sixth-generation carrier fighter — a full-scale development contract worth more than $20B. Boeing now holds both of the US military's sixth-gen fighter programs (with the Air Force's F-47).

catalysts.name: NICE Ltd.
catalysts.what: Oppenheimer upgraded to Outperform from Perform with a $150 target (about +35% above the current price), citing AI-platform strength, easing AI-disruption fears and the Cognigy acquisition. Thin tape: avg volume (606K) is only just above the 500K floor.

CCL.what: Global cruise operator running Carnival, Princess, Holland America and other brands across roughly 700 ports worldwide.

AKAM.what: Provides cloud security, content delivery and edge-compute services that protect and speed up websites, apps and streaming.

BA.what: Builds commercial airliners and military aircraft/defense systems; also runs space and global-services divisions.

NICE.what: Sells AI-powered cloud software for customer-service engagement and financial-crime/compliance detection.
